mechanism.who_is_forced_or_slow: At a 252-session (approx 1-year) low the marginal seller is a FORCED seller: stop-loss orders parked under the salient level, margin-call liquidations, risk-manager de-risking, and systematic breakdown rules all fire mechanically on the break. When the SAME session reclaims the level at the close, the sell supply below the level is exhausted (the forced sellers have already sold) and a DOWN-side crowd is now trapped: short sellers who pressed the breakdown must buy back to cover, and that covering demand is price-inelastic and unfolds over multiple sessions. The SLOW actors are discretionary risk managers, capitulated retail, and non-systematic holders who sold at the break and re-engage only after days; the unwind bounce therefore has a multi-session horizon, harvestable at a daily-or-slower EOD clock with no intraday data.
mechanism.why_the_effect_exists: Impact-reversal economics: much of a salient-level breakdown is TEMPORARY price impact from inelastic forced flow, not information. The same-session reclaim is the market's separator between informed continuation and forced-flow overshoot; names that reclaim exhibit (a) short-covering (forced buying), (b) reversion of impact-driven selling, and (c) market-maker inventory restocking at extremes. The claim is explicitly NOT about momentum or ranking: the anchor buys the failure of a downside break (a contrarian, event-conditioned, single-name book), the opposite exposure-form of every momentum ancestor that died in this program.
mechanism.observable: Single-name EOD event on the death-inclusive cohort, fully computable from one daily OHLCV series per name. Event E(i,t) fires when ALL of: (1) BREAK - session t's adjusted low < min of the prior 252 sessions' adjusted lows; (2) RECLAIM - session t's adjusted close > that same prior 252-session low; (3) RANGE PLACEMENT - (close_t - low_t)/(high_t - low_t) >= 0.5; (4) PARTICIPATION - dollar volume_t >= 1.5 x trailing 60-session median dollar volume. Bookability filters (declared ex ante, not tuned): adjusted close >= $1.00 and trailing 60-session median dollar volume >= $2M. All four conditions are known at session t's close; nothing is computed from future data.
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: (a) Deleveraging waterfalls: in 2008Q4-2009, 2020-03, and cohort-death spirals the first reclaim fails and the name keeps falling - the family carries NO regime gate by design; chronological folds spanning at least one major deleveraging regime plus the MDD/concentration gates are the preregistered killers. (b) Names that die within the horizon: force-flat at the last served session; deaths are INCLUDED (death-inclusive cohort honesty, M-I1 scoping) and a death-censoring invariance gate binds (excluding deaths must not flip the verdict; a verdict coupled to death-censoring is unbookable and recorded as such). (c) Empty-tape and sub-dollar artifacts: handled by the bookability filters and the band-cost ceiling; Q-6 feasibility is measured on the RECENT window at A9/P2, never the archive average. (d) Closing-auction paints of the reclaim: the range and volume conditions are the declared defense and C-RANGE-ONLY is the placebo that tests them. (e) The modal expected death: pooled |rho| > 0.20 at D2 vs the declared shadow inventory (short-term reversal, dollar-volume shock, vol states) - the NG-generation 0.20 bar has killed every NG proposal so far; this dossier treats pre-score veto as the most likely outcome and pre-registers it as a valid close.

data_authority.representation_single_convention: ONE frozen convention (P-12): the STATE (level break, reclaim, range placement, dollar-volume median) and the RETURNS are both computed on the SAME split+dividend-adjusted series (total-return basis). Rationale: a raw-price 252-session low can be a dividend/split artifact; on adjusted prices the level is corp-action-consistent and state and book are one representation. The SFV13 lesson (SH-A9 DIV-DECOMP-PRICEONLY 0.9994 killed STOCKS-NG5) is honored: D2 carries a NON-scored dividend-decomposition check (event-set overlap and rho between adjusted-basis and raw-basis event sets); if the event identity is dominated by its distribution component, that is recorded and the family is treated as dividend-artifact-contaminated, fail-closed.

entry_exit_fill_convention.anchor: Event fires at t close -> buy at t+1 regular-session open -> hold H=10 sessions -> exit at t+H+1 = t+11 open. Exactly 2 fills per round trip. Cost charged EXACTLY ONCE per fill. No leverage, long-only, no stop, no intraday management.
entry_exit_fill_convention.force_flat: Force-flat at every fold boundary and at name death (last served session; the death-session open if the name serves it, else the last served price with the event flagged DEATH_CENSORED and included in the book as-executed).
entry_exit_fill_convention.no_lookahead: PIT mutation control: recomputing every state input one session earlier must change or refuse the book (C-PIT-MUTATION); leak scan at Z phase checks every record depth for outcome-shaped fields.

anchor_arm.construction: The trap event exactly as specified in features_and_lags; every eligible event takes an equal-notional long leg; per-event expectancy is the primary accounting unit and the portfolio book (equal-weight all concurrent legs) is reported alongside for fold/MDD/concentration gates.
anchor_arm.declared_sign: HYPOTHESIS: reclaim of a failed 252-session-low breakdown is followed by positive multi-session drift (forced-covering unwind). Both directions are economically arguable ex ante (trap-bounce vs waterfall-continuation); the no-fail breakdown control carries the opposite-condition reading and R1 expectancy carries the sign test.

structural_neighbour_arm.construction: TWO-SESSION CONFIRMATION form of the same family information: the break session t qualifies identically, but entry additionally requires session t+1's adjusted close to hold above the broken level (the reclaim persisting one session); entry at t+2 open, same H=10, same filters, same costs/folds/accounting. It conditions on unwind PERSISTENCE rather than the single-session reclaim - a materially different construction of the same mechanism, not a lookback variant and not a sign inversion.
structural_neighbour_arm.non_degeneracy_and_identifiability: If the neighbour were merely the anchor with a different H it would be an ARM, not a neighbour. The preregistered self-subsumption check (P-20 books-distinct doctrine): pooled |rho| between the anchor and neighbour BOOK state series on the frozen decision grid must be <= 0.98, measured outcome-blind at D2; above it the neighbour is the same book and dies SELF-SUBSUMED, family continues anchor-only. Books-distinct is measurable from book geometry alone outcome-blind; if unmeasurable it is None fail-closed, never an inferred PASS.

There is no borrow-cost authority in the authorized evidence space (EODHD EOD serves no borrow/locate data; the FOREX-NG6 F4 cost-authority precedent class: an unmeasurable financing component is fail-closed, not assumed). The direction falsifier is therefore carried by (a) R1 net expectancy <= 0 and (b) C-NOFAIL-BREAKDOWN, the economically opposite-condition book (buying the raw break = the continuation hypothesis's long-side surrogate), both declared here BEFORE any outcome exists. This is an inversion-SUBSTITUTE, honestly labelled as such - not a true sign inversion.
